messages:
alejandro: Heads up — noticed a weird p99 jump for /api/v1/generate right after yesterday's routing change. dashboard shows p50/p95 stable but p99 spiked ~2x.
mira: ooh. did we change any sampling or attribution tags in routing? the dashboard p99 rollups are by "origin" tag.
sam: I pulled a couple traces. routing service is falling back to the small-variant when primary capacity is saturated, but it looks like we still mark requests as origin=primary even when fallthrough happens.
olivia: that would explain it — smaller model has much higher latency tail for larger prompts, so attributing those fallbacks to primary inflates p99 for primary route.
alejandro: correct. the confusion is the console endpoint breakdown currently surfaces percentiles by origin tag only. if routing marks origin before fallback we misattribute.
mira: quick repro query I ran (promql):

```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le, origin))
```

but origin is set by incoming route metadata, not final executor.
sam: @mira can you dump a small sample of requests showing route metadata vs executor model? sample looks like:

```
{"request_id":"r123","route":"primary","executor":"small-variant","duration_ms":1200}
```

we're tagging origin=primary
olivia: current options:
- change routing to set origin to final executor (accurate attribution)
- keep origin as intended route and add executor attr to dashboards (breakdown by executor)
- change console UI to show a combined view (route vs executed model)

alejandro: preference is (executor attr) + a footnote in rollout UX. For SLO docs we want to know what actually executed.
mira: agree. downside: legacy queries relying on origin semantics will change meaning. need migration plan and deprecation window.
sam: can we add a roll-forward: keep origin but add executor tag for 30 days, update dashboards to default to executor for percentile calculations, and then flip origin->executor attribution after customers are notified?
olivia: +1. Also need to ensure telemetry sampling keeps both tags for sampled traces (not just metrics), otherwise evals will be blind.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T18:12Z: routing-service v2.14 deployed to prod (feature: route-fallthrough-optimization)
alejandro: that deploy probably introduced the behavior — reverting is an option but we prefer telemetry fix.
mira: I'll open a small PR to attach executor_id to metrics emitted by the executor layer and update the console query templates to prefer executor when present.
sam: also we should add a small migration doc in eng-platform explaining how p50/p95/p99 semantics will change once we switch to executor attribution.
olivia: can we add a console toggle so ops can switch percentiles between origin vs executor? helps teams gradually adopt.
alejandro: good idea. Mira, Sam, can you coordinate on a short RFC and a patch? target whiteboard + PR by EOD tomorrow.
mira: on it. will post RFC link here when ready.
sam: I'll draft the migration note. will ping infra to keep both tags for 30 days.
olivia: thanks — this should stop the mystery p99 spikes and make rollouts less surprising.
alejandro: cool. filing a follow-up incident ticket to capture timelines and affected routes.
